scope: Right door only; left door and mullion unchanged
basis: User-approved zero-resistance simulation setting from G1 navigate replay comparison; not a measured hardware estimate
limitations: Right-door dry friction and viscous damping intentionally disabled; left door and mullion unchanged
Uniform mode is retained for replay compatibility but samples zero from [0, 0]
Seal force and real hardware resistance are not calibrated
Same-engine replay only; CPU PhysX validation does not imply GPU/hardware validation

physx.raw_usd: Zero right-door drive damping and max force; runtime adapter preserves zero in both fixed and uniform modes
physx.replay: assets SHA + runtime hash + image + sampled resistance + q/v/time; same-engine replay only
